sources.observation: The central fly tower and angled shells rise above one long, tan podium across the mapped site.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see image page
sources.observation: The curved, pale hulls overhang an entrance with tall piers and continuous recessed glazing. The south face has a broad stair landing.

limitations: The exterior photos and PMTiles guide the shell slopes, glass divisions and height estimates. The model covers the theater envelope and entry.
